title: Add production metrics exporter

context.summary: Expose production metrics for API, worker, queues and model operations.
context.background: Self-host users need scrapeable metrics rather than only in-process summaries.

in: Add Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint or exporter for API and worker.
Emit request, job, stage, queue, model, storage and vector metrics.
Protect metrics exposure with configuration and documented deployment guidance.
Add tests for metric names, labels and values.
Remove TASK-101-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: API and worker expose scrapeable metrics when enabled.
Metrics include counters and durations for requests, jobs, stages and model calls.
Queue depth and failure metrics are available.
Docs include a Prometheus scrape example.

manual_checks: Confirm metrics labels do not expose secrets or raw user content.

definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
